fusions.name: Spooled Under
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. You clamp on and roll, winding the line round the target. The roll deals 22 damage and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunken Tripwire
fusions.desc: Snaps a hidden line taut across a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 28 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snare That Waits
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to set a snare line at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles is caught: the snare deals 22 damage and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Snap Shut
fusions.desc: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, your physical damage rises 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
